traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Erythroxylaceae: leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules present; plants usually hermaphrodite, rarely dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 10; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
